title: Game Design — IoT Based Virtual Reality
subtitle: Product · Gaming

overview.label: Story
overview.heading: Overview
overview.body: A game-design exploration that connects IoT hardware to VR — mapping physical sensors and real-world inputs into a spatial game world, so the room and the body become part of the play.

problem.label: Problem
problem.heading: Why this needed to exist
problem.body: VR games often ignore the body and the room, keeping play trapped inside the headset; IoT offers a way to close that loop.

approach.label: Approach
approach.heading: How the work got done
approach.body: Designed game systems that bridge IoT sensors with VR interaction — mapping physical inputs into spatial rules and feedback.

outcomes.label: Outcomes
outcomes.heading: What changed once it shipped
outcomes.body: An early product/game experiment — 15 appreciations and 305 views on Behance — exploring how physical sensors can deepen spatial play.

credits.label: Credits
credits.heading: One last thing
credits.body: A VR game-design experiment connecting physical IoT sensors to spatial play — bringing the player's body and room into the virtual world.
